title: Crossover: classical vs learned policy, switched inside one balance
question: Does the learned policy really beat the classical controller, or was run 16's 1.17 deg a lucky segment?
headline: A lucky segment. Paired inside one continuous balance, classical is quieter in 5 of 6 cycles. But the policy travels 1.9x further per segment — which is exactly the mismatch the verifier flagged (wheel gain 0.148 vs 0.430, ratio 0.35) showing up on hardware as wandering into walls.
hub_output: cycle  classical RMS  policy RMS   diff | classical travel  policy travel
RMS classical 2.66 +- 2.03, policy 2.92 +- 1.32; classical quieter 5 of 6
travel median: classical 28 deg, policy 52 deg (1.9x)
all segments ran at a confirmed 200 Hz
